stem: A surveyor stands at point \(A\) on the straight bank of a river, directly across from a tree at point \(T\) on the opposite bank. She walks 60 meters along the bank to point \(B\) and measures angle \(ABT\) to be \(71^{\circ}\). To the nearest meter, how wide is the river?
solution: Triangle \(ABT\) has a right angle at \(A\). The river width \(AT\) is opposite the \(71^{\circ}\) angle, and \(AB = 60\) is adjacent to it.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{60}{\tan 71^{\circ}}\). The width is opposite the angle, so it equals \(60 \tan 71^{\circ}\), not \(60\) divided by it.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(60 \sin 71^{\circ}\), but 60 is a leg, not the hypotenuse.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{60}{\cos 71^{\circ}}\), the distance \(BT\) from the surveyor to the tree, not the width of the river.

verify:
ans=N(60*tan(71*pi/180))
assert abs(ans-174.2)<0.1
assert abs(value(choices[answer])-ans)<0.5
assert all(abs(value(choices[k])-ans)>0.5 for k in choices if k!=answer)
assert abs(value(choices['C'])-60/cos(71*pi/180))<0.5 and abs(value(choices['A'])-60/tan(71*pi/180))<0.5
